conditions: tsamp is taken from the instrument header and never re-binned
the drift window is searched to Nyquist, not capped below the lock
the advance is bounded to |k| = 1: k = 2 is outside Nyquist and k = 0 is a stationary line
the echo contrast is quoted only when nints >= 3948 (ten lags at the n/4 cap)
the chance rate is applied as a binomial over candidates
decision_rule: A candidate is locked when its drift is resolved, |k| = 1, and the lock distance is within 0.05. Report the count against the binomial null. If no candidate has a resolved drift the verdict is NOT MEASURED: the rate is not quoted, a null is not claimed, and a failure to resolve is never reported as a non-detection.

exploratory_excluded.status: exploratory, excluded from the confirmatory count

predictions.binomial_null: P(locked >= m | N evaluable) with p = chance_per_candidate

statistic.echo: mean |autocorrelation| at Fibonacci lags minus mean over all non-Fibonacci lags, as in scripts/phi_echo.py
statistic.lock_distance: |nu/theta - round(nu/theta)|, evaluated only for resolved drifts
statistic.rate: nu = drift * tsamp / channel, cycles per sample
